description: A word-level invented language: subject-object-verb; adjectives follow nouns; articles are omitted. An optional final English phrase near the LOCATION describes the object; Nemi places LOCATION na before the final verb.

split_notes.train: 16,000 unique sentences: 12,000 without and 4,000 with a location phrase.
split_notes.validation: 1,400 new sentences: 1,000 without and 400 with a location phrase.
split_notes.test_familiar: 1,800 new sentences with two adjectives: 1,200 without and 600 with a location phrase. All adjective-noun pairs were allowed in training.
split_notes.test_new_pairs: 1,800 new sentences with two adjectives and exactly one held-out pair: 1,200 without and 600 with a location phrase. Every held-out pair occurs 150 times in each grammatical role.
split_notes.contrast_sets: Nine reserved sentences, absent from all four splits. Three include a location phrase. All adjective-noun pairs were allowed in training.
split_notes.locations: Location variants keep their underlying sentence in the same split. The two test sets have identical location-word counts and sentence-length distributions.
